All it took was a "Pavel" to ruin our fondness of your restaurant
Oct 2026 • Family
Dear Refinery,
You held a special place for me and my husband. We always loved the atmosphere, food and service. Don't get me wrong, you food is still good and your staff are sweet and professional as always. Saturday night made me look at your restaurant in a different light. My family (me, husband, daughter and baby) came to your restaurant for dinner. We hadn't made a reservation. A vietnamese staff at the entrance was trying to see if we can be accommodated. The assistant manager Pavel told us they were full. So we went next door for dinner. After dinner we were craving dessert especially your crepe suzette flambed. We thought we would check if there was availability at your restaurant. When we got there, the staff at the entrance said we could sit at the bar. Once inside, staff told us that a table would be free soon and we would be moved from the bar area to the main dining area. For some reason that didnt sit well with your manager. Suddenly we saw your assistant manager Pavel turn up and looked obviously upset about it and was lecturing the staff. It looked like a big issue because there was alot of talks being given to the staff inside the restaurant and then they were given a talk outside the restaurant. After that the staff kept apologizing to us and feeling really bad about not being able to seat us at the regualr tables. We were ok with that. Pavel had no deceny to approach us to sort anything out.
In fact he earlier told us that a child seat was not available while it was clearly unused in a corner. 

 We started to feel very uncomfortable like we were not welcomed there at all by him. I even told one of your staff, if it's an issue we are here, then we will leave beacuse of all the bickering we saw. Pavel went out of his way to ensure we were not welcomed at your restaurant. 

The amount of times he was cribbing at the staff who had accomodated us and passing comments like "i'm an idiot" to them. We wanted to leave. But after all the trouble and crap the staff were getting, we stayed but changed the order to something we could get quicker. Mind you we were full aware of walk-ins that were happily being accomodated. When waiting to pay the bill, Pavel happened to pass by and my husband was handing him the bill folder. He just walked by snatched it without stopping or acknowledging us. We felt sick in our stomach. 

The no.of times your other staff apologised, including those who knew us from before, was really sad. Your assistant managers behaviour was very unprofessional, appears he lacks experience in this industry and bordered on immature. An individual like him will ruin the reputation of a Saigon institution.
